title: 第5章 疯狂星期四特惠第6章 什么还有月卡
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
——身份及体检报告（李清然）——
＜姓名：李清然＞
＜当前境界：炼气一层＞
＜身份：前青云宗，赤霄峰弟子＞
＜年龄：19（女）＞
＜特殊天赋：单水灵根（已废）、太阴道体（未激活）＞
＜状态：根基受损、丹田破裂、火毒噬体、心魔滋生、严重内伤（经脉尽断）、中度外伤＞
＜生平：曾是青云宗赤霄峰内门弟子，然被奸人所害，导致其与师门反目。李清然修为被大师兄【陆长天】所废，灵根为师父青玄道人剥离，体内火毒源自二师兄【萧一峰】所炼废丹，后被三师兄【云子墨】联合外门长老将其逐出宗门，四师兄【张寒啸】将其引入破草屋中令其自生自灭。道心种魔，心魔之一为奸人所种，心魔之二为自己产生（点击展开详细版）＞
＜综评：命途多舛，风中残烛。＞
————————————————
看完李清然的体检和身份报告，陈怀安整个人都傻了。
不是哥们儿，咋给他干女频来了？况且，他身上顶多就癌症一个debuff，李清然足足五个啊！
而且这妹纸也太惨了吧！什么仇什么怨，不就是宗门大比的时候刺中小师妹的肩膀吗？既然是修真界，刀剑无眼，宗门比试受个伤有什么问题？结果一整个赤霄峰全部都受刺激化身超雄了！这其中莫非有什么隐秘？
“难怪瑟缩在这么一个破茅屋里，要不是我来的及时，她估计真没了。”看着房间里盘坐在椅子上闭眼入定的李清然，陈怀安不自觉地就代入进去，好像李清然是真实存在的，这也不是游戏。
“这个样子是在修炼吧？根基被毁，灵根也没了，还能修炼吗？”陈怀安点住李清然，出于尊重，他点住的是李清然的肩膀，而不是其他什么奇怪的地方。
【状态：修炼中】
【修炼进度：3999】
这个意思应该是灵气积攒到99才能进阶练气二层？
陈怀安暗自推测，没注意到李清然微红的耳根。
他就这么瞅着李清然修炼了半小时。

而李清然的修炼进度不仅没动，还掉了一格，变成了38。
画面中的少女也皱起眉头，苍白的嘴唇微微下撇，我见犹怜。
“她应该也感觉到灵气不进反退了吧……”
陈怀安又开始到处找按钮，看看能不能帮助李清然加快修炼进度。
而且李清然身上还有那么多伤，就这么放着只会越来越糟。
翻找半天，给李清然疗伤的选项没找到，有个电子女友商店是未解锁的，他终于在右上角一个阵法的图标里找到可能对李清然有用的东西。
【初级聚灵阵：观看广告可解锁一小时】
【中级聚灵阵：观看广告可解锁10分钟】
【高级聚灵阵：188￥一小时，需观看广告。＜疯狂星期四特惠（原价488小时）＞】
除了聚灵阵之外下面还有一溜各种各样的阵法。
比如什么隐匿阵、玄甲阵，还有看名字就很牛的诛仙阵，这些阵法有的要花钱买，有的要满足各种稀有条件，很多条件他都看不懂。
例如顶级阵法之一的‘十方血煞屠天大阵’，需要集齐12把最低灵器级别的凶器，配合一大堆复杂的材料才能启动。关键是这些材料上哪找？花钱买？游戏送？还是要让李清然去找，就跟旅行青蛙一样？
“又是特惠！还疯狂星期四呐？”陈怀安咬牙切齿。
明天高级聚灵阵就恢复原价了，到时候再想用不划算。
伸头一刀缩头也是一刀。
content_en:
——Identity and physical examination report (Li Qingran)——
＜Name: Li Qingran＞
＜Current state: Level 1 of Qi refining＞
<Identity: Former Qingyun Sect, disciple of Chixiao Peak>
＜Age: 19 (female)＞
＜Special Talents: Single Water Spiritual Root (obsolete), Taiyin Body (inactive)＞
＜Status: Damaged foundation, ruptured Dantian, consuming fire poison, growth of inner demons, severe internal injuries (meridians severed), moderate trauma＞
<Life: He was once a disciple of the inner sect of Qingyun Sect, Chixiao Peak, but he was killed by a traitor, which caused him to fall out with his master. Li Qingran's cultivation was deposed by his senior brother [Lu Changtian], and his spiritual roots were stripped away by his master Qingxuan Taoist. The fire poison in his body came from the waste elixir refined by the second senior brother [Xiao Yifeng]. Later, the third senior brother [Yun Zimo] and the elders of the outer sect expelled him from the sect, and the fourth senior brother [Zhang Hanxiao] introduced him to a dilapidated thatched house to let him fend for himself. Demons are planted in the Taoist heart. One of the inner demons is planted by the traitor, and the second inner demon is produced by oneself (click to expand the detailed version)>
＜Comprehensive review: The fate is full of misfortune, and the candle remains in the wind. ＞
————————————————
After reading Li Qingran's physical examination and identity report, Chen Huaian was stunned.
If you're not a buddy, why did you give him a sex video? Besides, he only has one cancer debuff at most, and Li Qingran has five debuffs!
And this girl is too miserable! What kind of hatred or resentment? Wasn't it just that he stabbed the junior sister in the shoulder during the sect competition? Since this is the world of cultivation and swords have no eyes, what's the problem with being injured in a sect competition? As a result, the entire Chixiao Peak was stimulated and transformed into super heroes! Is there some secret in this?
"No wonder she is huddled in such a broken hut. If I hadn't arrived in time, she would have died." Looking at Li Qingran sitting cross-legged on a chair in the room with his eyes closed, Chen Huaian unconsciously took it in, as if Li Qingran existed for real and this was not a game.
"You are practicing like this, right? With your foundation destroyed and your spiritual roots gone, can you still practice?" Chen Huaian clicked on Li Qingran. Out of respect, he clicked on Li Qingran's shoulder instead of any other strange place.
[Status: practicing]
[Cultivation progress: 3999]
This should mean that you can advance to the second level of Qi training after accumulating spiritual energy to 99?
Chen Huaian secretly speculated, not noticing Li Qingran's slightly red ears.
He just watched Li Qingran practice for half an hour.
Li Qingran's cultivation progress not only remained unchanged, but also dropped one level to 38.
The girl in the picture also frowned, and her pale lips curled down slightly, which made me feel pity for her.
"She should also feel that the spiritual energy is retreating instead of advancing..."
Chen Huaian started looking for buttons again to see if he could help Li Qingran speed up his cultivation progress.
Moreover, Li Qingran still has so many injuries, leaving them like this will only get worse.
After searching for a long time, he couldn't find the option to heal Li Qingran. There was an electronic girlfriend store that was not unlocked. He finally found something that might be useful to Li Qingran in a formation icon in the upper right corner.
[Elementary Spirit Gathering Array: Watch ads to unlock for one hour]
[Intermediate Spirit Gathering Array: Watch ads to unlock 10 minutes]
[Advanced Spirit Gathering Array: 188￥one hour, need to watch ads. ＜Crazy Thursday Special (original price 488 hours)＞】
In addition to the spirit gathering formation, there are also a variety of formations below.
For example, the Concealment Formation, the Mysterious Armor Formation, and the Zhuxian Formation, which looked awesome just by the name. Some of these formations had to be purchased with money, and some had to meet various rare conditions, many of which he couldn't understand.
For example, one of the top formations, the 'Ten Directions Blood Fiend Slaughtering Heaven Array', requires the collection of 12 weapons of the lowest spiritual level and a lot of complex materials to activate. The key is where to find these materials? Spend money on it? Games for free? Or should Li Qingran look for it, just like a traveling frog?
"Another special offer! Crazy Thursday?" Chen Huaian gritted his teeth.The high-level spirit gathering array will return to its original price tomorrow, and it won't be worthwhile to use it again then.
Extending one's head and retracting one's head are also one knife.
